does: Cuts corn tortillas into strips or wedges and shallow-fries them in hot oil until rigid, golden and crisp.
how: Cut the tortillas into thin strips or wedges. Slightly stale ones fry crisper.
Heat a finger's depth of oil in a deep pan until a strip sizzles at once.
Fry in small batches, turning, until golden and the bubbling slows.
Lift out onto kitchen paper and salt them while hot.

cues.text: The fierce bubbling quietens as the water leaves the strips.
They snap instead of bending once cool.

mistakes.mistake: Crowding the pan, which cools the oil and leaves the strips greasy and limp.
mistakes.fix: Fry a small handful at a time.

mistakes.mistake: Taking them too dark, which turns them bitter.
mistakes.fix: Lift them out at golden; they darken a little as they cool.
